vulnerability.name: GO-2026-5932
vulnerability.description: golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp is unmaintained and unsafe by design

statements.impact_statement: wdbgp imports only golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt (password hashing). The deprecated openpgp packages this advisory covers are not in the dependency graph of the shipped binary: `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp` reports the main module does not need it, `go list -deps ./cmd/wdbgp` links zero openpgp packages, and govulncheck's symbol-level analysis in CI classifies this advisory as required-but-never-called. The advisory has no fixed version (the package is deprecated, not patched), so upgrading golang.org/x/crypto cannot clear it.
